subject: [PATCH 06/11] nfsd: pin the client while a GETATTR holds a conflicting delegation

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the NFS server where a client could be freed while it is still holding a delegation, causing a crash when the GETATTR operation tries to access the freed client. The patch introduces two new functions: nfsd4_get_leased_deleg and nfsd4_put_leased_deleg, which take a reference on both the delegation and the client while the lease is held, ensuring that the client remains alive until the delegation is released. This prevents the crash and ensures correct behavior in this scenario.
